title: 第13章 唐天的资质第14章 神族
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 从天而降的一道道雷电被唐天不断炼化，整个人的体表都散发着一种雷电的光泽。
落星森林上空，雷电消失，乌云已经散去。
唐天浑身上下湿溻溻，已经分不清是雨水，还是汗水，焦黑的身体，衣服褴褛，如同乞丐。
此时此刻，这一切唐天都没有去管。
元力在体内涌动，雷光闪烁，汹涌澎湃。
便是焚血境高阶大圆满的修者，其体内的力量也绝对比不上唐天。
“这小子，还真是一个奇迹……”
凡爷自言自语。
不得不说，唐天给了他一个意料之外的惊喜。
原本唐天一直压制着修为，可现在如同江河漫过堤坝，无法再压制。
“突破！”
唐天立即做出决定，水到渠成突破焚血境。
焚血境，顾名思义，燃烧鲜血，将自身鲜血统统换掉，以自身功法属性为主，成就血液颜色。
例如，主修冰属性功法之人，鲜血便会是蓝色的。
修炼杀戮属性功法之人，鲜血则会是深红色。
各种功法，各种颜色，不一而足。
“小子，你现在可以突破到焚血境。
不过，爷建议你，在得到塔的传承之前，还是不要去焚烧血液。”
凡爷急忙出言阻止，唐天虽说重活一世，可毕竟前一世最擅长的方面，是炼制丹药。
唐天闻言后，不免犹豫起来。
要知道，他来到落星森林，为的就是做出突破提升修为。
若是能够一鼓作气，提升到焚血境高阶的话，以他现在的基础，与锻骨境高阶一战，也不是不可以。
“小子，你忘了，九转天雷诀第二转的要求是什么？”
凡爷何尝不知道唐天心里在想什么，不由的嗤笑一声。
“第二转……”
九转天雷诀，第一转就这么变态要人命，这才过去，唐天到现在还心有余悸。
一想到第二转的要求，倒是让他双眼一亮，有了兴趣。
“好，就先突破境界再说。”
唐天运转体内力量，跨入焚血境也只是水到渠成而已。
content_en:
The streaks of thunder and lightning that fell from the sky were continuously refined by Tang Tian, ​​and his entire body exuded a luster of thunder and lightning.
Over the Luoxing Forest, the thunder and lightning disappeared and the dark clouds dispersed.
Tang Tian was soaked all over, he couldn't tell whether it was rain or sweat. His body was charred and his clothes were ragged, like a beggar.
At this moment, Tang Tian didn't care about all this.
Yuanli surges in the body, lightning flashes, and surges.
Even a high-level Dzogchen cultivator in the Burning Blood Realm has absolutely no power in his body compared to Tang Tian.
"This kid is really a miracle..."
Master Fan said to himself.
It has to be said that Tang Tian gave him an unexpected surprise.
Originally, Tang Tian had been suppressing his cultivation, but now it was like a river overflowing a dam, unable to suppress it any longer.
"Breakthrough!"
Tang Tian immediately made a decision to break through to the Burning Blood Realm.
Burning blood realm, as the name suggests, burns blood, replaces one's own blood heritage, and uses one's own skills and attributes as the main one to achieve the color of blood.
For example, the blood of a person who majors in ice-based skills will be blue.
The blood of people who practice killing attribute skills will be dark red.
Various techniques, various colors, just to name a few.
“Boy, you can break through to the Burning Blood Realm now.
However, I suggest you not to burn blood before you get the inheritance from the tower. "
Master Fan hurriedly spoke to stop him. Although Tang Tian wanted to live a new life, after all, what he was best at in his previous life was refining elixirs.
"This..."
After Tang Tian heard this, he couldn't help but hesitate.
You know, he came to Luo Xing Forest to make breakthroughs and improve his cultivation.
If he could work hard and advance to the high level of Burning Blood Realm, with his current foundation, it would not be impossible for him to fight against the high level of Bone Forging Realm.
"Boy, have you forgotten, what are the requirements for the second turn of the Nine-turn Heavenly Thunder Technique?"
Master Fan didn't know what Tang Tian was thinking, so he couldn't help but sneer.
"The second turn..."
The first turn of the Nine Turns of Heavenly Thunder Technique was so abnormal that it cost people lives. It just passed. Tang Tian still has lingering fears.
When he thought of the request for the second round, his eyes lit up and he became interested.
"Okay, let's break through the realm first."
Tang Tian circulated the power in his body and entered the Burning Blood Realm. It was just a matter of course.
"receive!"
